title: Solver-facing fallback indicator diagnosis
motivation: Exact retention/capacity restores the O05-dry prescribed-qbot nonlinear path while exact K does not. A bounded fallback is attractive only if its trigger can be based on solver-relevant quantities rather than material identity.
question: Do accepted-state constitutive and Jacobian-scaled diagnostics expose a material-independent signal associated with the known retention-sensitive nonlinear-path failures?
known_evidence_set: F-AHL21C 12-case qbot matrix at factor 0.99 and dt=0.0625 day: 11 pass, O05-dry path failure
F-AHL12 B01-wet qbot=1e-6 cm/day and dt=0.01 day: endpoint fidelity pass but nonlinear path failure
diagnostics: lookup support interval width in log10(-h)
boundary flux magnitude normalized by authoritative K(initial)
rules: No threshold selected in F-AHL22 is a qualification result because known failure labels are already available.
No material identifier may be used as a trigger variable.
No solver outcome or iteration count may be used as a runtime trigger variable.
Any candidate trigger emerging from this diagnosis must be frozen before testing new cases in F-AHL23.
